faq.q: Can I come on my own?
faq.a: Of course. Seats are booked individually, and at the chef's table you often sit with other lovers of good food.

faq.q: What if I have an allergy or don't eat meat?
faq.a: Let us know in your booking at least [N] days before the evening and the chef will adapt the courses.

faq.q: Is the wine pairing included in the price?
faq.a: [Yes / No, it is [PRICE] extra.] A non-alcoholic pairing is available on request.

faq.q: How do I pay, and what if I cancel?
faq.a: [Your seat is confirmed with a deposit. Cancellation terms.]

faq.a: Yes, with a Chef's Table gift voucher.
